title: Fixed-term Employees (Prevention of Less Favourable Treatment) Regulations 2002
summary: Fixed-term employees must not be treated less favourably than comparable permanent employees unless objectively justified (reg 3), including being told about permanent vacancies; written statement of reasons (reg 5); after four years' continuous employment on successive fixed-term contracts a renewal takes effect as permanent unless objectively justified or a collective or workforce agreement modifies the rule (reg 8); written statement of permanent status (reg 9).

title: Fixed-term Employees (Prevention of Less Favourable Treatment) Regulations (Northern Ireland) 2002
summary: Northern Ireland equivalent: no less favourable treatment unless objectively justified (reg 3), written statement of reasons (reg 5), successive fixed-term contracts and the four-year rule (reg 8), written statement of variation (reg 9). Complaints go to an industrial tribunal.

title: Expiry of a limited-term contract without renewal is a dismissal (unfair dismissal and redundancy)
summary: Employment Rights Act 1996 s.95(1)(b) (unfair dismissal) and s.136(1)(b) (redundancy): a limited-term contract ending by its limiting event without renewal counts as a dismissal. Whether it is fair, or whether a redundancy payment is due, depends on the reason, the process and the length of service.

title: Expiry of a limited-term contract without renewal is a dismissal (Northern Ireland)
summary: Employment Rights (Northern Ireland) Order 1996 Article 127(1)(b) (unfair dismissal) and Article 171(1)(b) (redundancy): a limited-term contract ending by its limiting event without renewal counts as a dismissal.
